title: anisomeris oligantha
intro: Anisomeris oligantha, commonly known as Desert Tobacco or False Tobacco, is a plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Anisomeris oligantha include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic, making it useful for relieving muscle spasms and reducing pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and other compounds, although more research is needed to fully understand its properties and potential uses.
